import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert StichtagDat to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Plot the distribution of dog ages
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterVHundNum'], kde=True, bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages')

plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output_ages.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Rasse1Text', data=data, order=data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().index[:10])
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_breeds.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.title('Distribution of Dog Genders')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks([1, 2], ['männlich', 'weiblich'])
plt.savefig('output_genders.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
